3. Mrs Nusrat Jahan, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the defendant suggested only a point to be added and investigated upon by the learned Advocate Commissioner at the time of effecting commission, whether BS khatian recorded in the name of the plaintiff and BS khatian recorded in the name of the defendant and the plots therein corresponds each other, but the trial court without assigning any reason in a very slipshod manner rejected the application, hence, committed an error of law in the decision occasioning failure of justice. 

 4. Mr Shamim Khaled Ahmed, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the opposite party submits that the petitioner by filing an application tried to add a point for local investigation relating to BS khatian and plots therein. The point has already been suggested by the plaintiff in their application as point No.4 and the same can be easily solved and replied by the Advocate Commissioner, as such, the application filed by the defendant is redundant but on)/ to delay the disposal of the suit. 

 7. On the other hand, after allowing application for investigation the defendant suggested a point to be ascertained by the same Advocate Commissioner in addition to point given by the plaintiff. In the situation, usually the court should have allowed the application as both the parties to the proceedings are claiming the property to be their acquired property and for the purpose of determination of the dispute between the parties, the trial court ought to have allowed the application filed by the defendant, but from the face of the application filed by the defendant, it appears that they stated that the property owned by the defendant are not the property claimed by the plaintiff. It is also claimed that the plaintiff property recorded in their names under BS khatian No. 3, but the property claim by the defendant stands recorded under BS Khatian No. 866 which is totally different from the suit land, as such, to ascertain whether the property claimed by the plaintiff and the property claimed by the defendant local investigation on the point is required to be held and for the purpose the defendant also suggested a point, but the application contains no such point to be ascertained by the advocate commissioner. However, while the trial court rejecting the application for local investigation it ought to have given some reasons and passed a speaking order, but the order under challenge is not a speaking order rather it was passed in a very slipshod manner which is not at all desirable from a Judge holding the post of Joint District Judge.
